notes.title: Ultimate Jello Party - 2025 Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone, how’s it going?

We've always valued honesty and believe that amazing games are made with a lot of respect and care for the players. Developing a game is full of challenges and surprises, and things don't always go exactly as planned.

But we’re excited to share with you our Roadmap leading up to version 1.0!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixANlKX.png[/img]

With this Roadmap, we’ve outlined a plan that we believe will meet everyone’s interests.

UwU Games Team

notes.title: Ultimate Jello Party will arrive a little later, but better than ever!
notes.content:
A message to our fans,

We would like to share an important update regarding the release of our game. After careful consideration, we have decided to delay the launch of Ultimate Jello Party, which was originally scheduled for the first quarter of 2025. The new release date is now set for the second quarter of 2025.

We understand that this news may be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize to everyone who was eagerly looking forward to playing. Our commitment is to deliver the best possible experience, and this extra time will allow us to refine the current experience and address important details to ensure we release a game that meets your — and our — expectations.

We will continue to share updates on the development process.

Sincerely,
UwU Team

notes.title: Work in Progress: Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
]Has it been a month already? Is it December now? Time flies so fast!

Hello everyone,
We’re back with another Dev Blog to share the recent progress we’ve made in developing our game.

[h2]Death Effects[/h2]
We’ve added a new visual effect for those moments when... poof... you’re dead.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S9Rci9j.gif[/img]

[h2]Sounds That Bring Life[/h2]
Recently, we completed a series of sound effects covering key gameplay aspects. Now, every movement, attack, impact, and even character death has its own sound.

[h2]Give me a Chest[/h2]
Earning cards just got even more fun.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nGGNHrF.gif[/img]

[h2]New Minigames[/h2]
We’ve created two new minigames! The concepts were already complete, and now they’re ready: Among Count and Quick Souls

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7mkbP1e.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cn5dMGb.png[/img]

Additionally, we’ve translated our Steam page into multiple languages. And something super exciting happened—one of our developers got married! 

That’s all for now! Thank you for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to show you more. Feel free to share your thoughts about these updates or ask questions by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/jzfwYmkr4E]Discord[/url].

We wish you all a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

- UwU Team

notes.title: Work in Progress: Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, how's it going? Welcome to the Update Diary!

Each month, we’ll share improvements and new features from our little game.

[h2]Development[/h2]
We faced challenges with the lack of Godot tutorials and the version transition, but we’re adapting.
[list]
[*] Dasij and Rheidner are our devs. Dasij is also a game designer, always crafting new mechanics and refining minigame logic. Rheidner, on the other hand, focused on enhancing multiplayer, developing a semi-authoritative version. [/list] Bugs like to drop by to say "hello," but this team is always on top of fixing them 💪

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wmud3FX.gif[/img]

[h2]Our "Van Goghs"[/h2]
Our art trio—Dan, Opala, and Bacchox—is bringing the game's visuals to life.
[list] [*] Dan is handling menu art, credits, and transitions. We’re still prototyping, but it already looks fantastic! [/list] [list] [*] And Opala... she's practically a goddess when it comes to creation! She’s bringing the board to life, populating every area with penguins, trees, reindeer—her own creations. [/list] [list] [*] Lastly, Bacchox is working on card effects, and the results are incredible! It’s that level of intricate detail, with multiple frames, that truly makes a difference. [/list]
In October, we even celebrated Dan and Opala's birthdays 🥳

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gO34AMh.gif[/img]
[h2]Feel the Vibe[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pedro, in addition to being an artist, is also the team's sound designer. This month, he brought Opala's penguins to life with sound. I can only imagine what his neighbors think while he records! He also started concept art for another minigame. [/list]

Lastly, we're always sharing updates on our social media, so stay tuned! And here’s exciting news: our game is about to enter Beta!

Thanks for reading! I'll be back with more updates for you all next month!  
- Gunnar
